title: x402-mcp
description: Pay for HTTP APIs and charge for your own: x402 micropayments in USDC on Base.
summary: Pay for HTTP APIs and charge for your own: x402 micropayments in USDC on Base.
offersHint: Pay for HTTP APIs and charge for your own: x402 micropayments in USDC on Base. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://x402-mcp.onrender.com/mcp/mcp

toolsPreview.name: discover_services
toolsPreview.description: Discover x402 Bazaar paid HTTP services via x402 HTTPFacilitatorClient.

toolsPreview.name: get_payment_requirements
toolsPreview.description: Probe a URL for x402 payment requirements using x402HTTPClient SDK.

toolsPreview.name: pay_and_fetch
toolsPreview.description: Pay via x402HttpxClient and fetch a protected HTTP resource.

toolsPreview.name: build_seller_requirements
toolsPreview.description:
Build seller-side x402 payment requirements via x402ResourceServer.

    Pass resource_url (plus optional discovery_* fields) to embed the Bazaar
    discovery extension so a settled payment catalogs the endpoint.

toolsPreview.name: get_supported_networks
toolsPreview.description: List networks, facilitators, and v2 headers via x402 SDK.

toolsPreview.name: get_pro_upgrade_requirements
toolsPreview.description: Build x402 payment requirements to purchase Pro tier (revenue collection).

toolsPreview.name: activate_pro_tier
toolsPreview.description: Verify pro-tier x402 payment and unlock Pro quota limits.

toolsPreview.name: get_tool_credits_requirements
toolsPreview.description: Build x402 payment requirements to purchase per-use MCP tool credits.

toolsPreview.name: purchase_tool_credits
toolsPreview.description: Verify x402 payment and add per-use tool credits (per-call revenue path).

toolsPreview.name: create_stripe_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Create Stripe Checkout Session for pro tier or tool credits (fiat rail).

toolsPreview.name: run_swarm_research
toolsPreview.description:
Run the swarm Agency: compose a research product and list it for resale.

    Spends nothing by default — the report is synthesized from free inputs, so
    unsold inventory costs nothing. Pass allow_paid_inputs=True to buy upstream
    x402 services first (buy → compose → list), which books a cost basis before
    knowing whether the composite will sell.

toolsPreview.name: settle_composite_sale
toolsPreview.description:
Verify + settle a buyer's x402 payment for a listed composite product and
    record the realized revenue (sell side).

toolsPreview.name: swarm_revenue_report
toolsPreview.description:
Portfolio revenue intelligence for the swarm: spend, revenue, LTV:CAC,
    margins, per-source profit scores.

toolsPreview.name: get_base_pulse
toolsPreview.description:
Live Base Network Pulse: synthesized settlement-conditions intelligence
    (base fee, EIP-1559 projection, utilization trend, USD settlement cost, and a
    settle-now/hold verdict) computed from real Base RPC data + ETH spot price.

toolsPreview.name: get_os_metrics
toolsPreview.description:
Host OS telemetry: CPU, memory, swap, disk, network, and process
    signals with an ok/warn/critical health verdict, sampled live from the
    machine running the server. Optionally includes the top processes by
    memory.
